page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (small italic notes at the top right, beside the first paragraph); running head at top; signature "ddd 3" at the foot with catchword "Magos" at the right.

p.i: Ille cœtus impietate Magica graviter se polluit, adeoque, cœteris paribus, Babylon Magna est, qui idololatriam propalam exercet; Magicam impietatem extenuat; religionem universam ejusdem impietatis labe attaminat; cum dæmonibus & mortuis hominibus, ad veritatem ex iis expiscandam, familiare commercium colit; verbum Dei in exorcismis & benedictionibus profanat; Baptismum exorcismis contaminat; in Eucharistia certorum verborum murmure corpus Christi excantat; unctionibus certis, chrismati inprimis in Sacramentis spuriis, effectus tribuit, quos nec à natura, nec à Deo supra naturam operante habent; amuletis benedictis, verbis, figuris & numeris efficaciam tribuit; fortuitis significationem affingit; Magiam per remedia magica depellere conatur; Magos profossos, & scripta consuetudinésque notorie Magicas in sinu suo fovet; Magos levibus pœnis afficit; denique nullam criminis hujus emendationem patitur.

main_text.p: Atqui Hierarchia, seu Clerus Ecclesiæ Romanæ dominans idololatriam propalam exercet; Magicam impietatem extenuat: religionem universam impietatis ejusdem labe attaminat; cum dæmonibus & hominibus mortuis, ad veritatem ex iis expiscandam, familiare commercium colit; Verbum Dei in exorcismis & benedictionibus profanat; Baptismum exorcismis variis contaminat; in Eucharistia certorum verborum murmure corpus Christi excantat; unctionibus certis, chrismati inprimis, in Sacramentis spuriis eos effectus tribuit, quos nec à natura, nec à Deo supra naturam operante habent; amuletis benedictis, verbis, figuris & numeris efficaciam tribuit; fortuitis significationem affingit; Magiam per remedia magica depellere conatur; Magos profossos, & scripta consuetudinésque notorie Magicas in sinu fovet;

page.notes: Marginal notes at top right are small and heavily damaged (e.g. "apodissitio", "pragitur", "Propositio", "nis atrins", "que membrā", "sigillatim", "probantur"); they are only partly legible and are not transcribed. Scan edges and a faint watermark ("Digitized by Google") at the bottom right are omitted. Some words in the body are doubtful, notably "profossos" and "Magicas" and the Greek-less passages, which are marked as printed.
